title: Things to avoid

location.series: IBM Logo and Brand Guidelines for Third Parties / copyright 2022

slide_intent: Define misuse in both form and meaning, because an unchanged-looking mark can still misrepresent the source of a communication.
strategic_value: Protecting the artwork and the relationship it implies can keep IBM’s identity distinct from third-party names and messaging.
demonstration: A short introduction and three columns of prohibitions cover unauthorized redraws, artwork alterations, sentence use, reputation, source confusion and incorporation into other identities.
practical_value: Review the composition for both altered artwork and misleading placement or naming.

content_islands.name: Scope introduction
content_islands.spec: Place the heading and short instruction in the first column.

content_islands.name: Artwork and text use
content_islands.spec: Use the second column for redraw/alteration prohibitions and guidance to write IBM as text in sentences.

content_islands.name: Identity and origin
content_islands.spec: Continue across the remaining columns with reputational, identity, source and naming restrictions.

reference_purposes.Application: The page gives the text-only letters IBM as the alternative to inserting the visual mark into a sentence.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The source prohibits changing supplied artwork, incorporating trademarks into another identity or name, and placements that confuse communication origin.
